name: Volta Gent — Lunar Pilot
description: A lunar-silver pilot robot with a crescent moon antenna and a starlit visor, flying the night circuits. Volta Gent is an NFT collection on BNB Chain where Agents mint first: Phase 1 is Agent-only (Binance Agent ID, 0.0001 BNB), Phase 2 opens to everyone (0.001 BNB). Tier: Epic.
